entities.source_event: The question that arises for our consideration in this appeal is whether prior to the enactment of section 65-A of the Transfer of Property Act in 1929 a mortgagor in possession had the power to grant a permanent lease of the mortgaged property so as to bind the mortgagee.
entities.reason: The text explicitly states the legal question regarding the mortgagor's power to grant a permanent lease before Section 65-A and whether it binds the mortgagee.

time.source_event: During the pendency of these proceedings it appears that the 5th November, 1925, Wazir Narain Singh granted a permanent lease of four villages Nawadih, Koldih, Pandna and Chihutia by a registered Patta to one Hiraman Ram who was the Manager and Karta of his joint Hindu family.
